description: This PHP source file defines the class UsersViewList, which extends ViewList, and manages the user list view in the SuiteCRM user interface. It includes methods for access control, list processing, and rendering the user list with specific filters and search functionalities.

classes.name: UsersViewList
classes.description: A view class responsible for displaying the list of users, with access control and list rendering functionalities.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Checks if the current user has admin or developer access for the Users module; redirects unauthorized users; initializes the list view object.

methods.name: listViewProcess
methods.description: Processes the list view, handles search forms, applies filters, and renders the user list if headers are set.
